contracts.statement: An instant vector selector resolves to the single most recent sample within the default 5-minute lookback, evaluated at query time.
A range vector selector's window is anchored to the evaluation timestamp, not to the request's [start,end), and every sample it returns falls strictly inside (evalTs-range, evalTs].
blind_spots: Subquery-nested range vectors are covered by a separate contract, not this one.

contracts.statement: A LogQL regex line filter (|~) matches using RE2 semantics identical to Loki's, including case-insensitive (?i) and multiline anchors.
blind_spots: Backreferences are rejected identically to Loki, but that rejection path is not yet covered by this contract.

contracts.statement: A TraceQL attribute comparison against a typed literal (duration, number, status) coerces a differently-typed stored attribute the same way Tempo does, rather than silently failing to match.
blind_spots: Coercion of array-valued attributes is entirely unexercised.
contracts.deficit_reason: No differential harness case exercises typed-literal coercion against a mismatched stored attribute type yet; tracked as a known gap rather than silently marked active.

contracts.statement: A label matcher's equality and regex semantics behave identically across every head that parses one, independent of that head's own query syntax.
blind_spots: TraceQL's attribute matcher is a distinct grammar and is not yet covered by this contract.

contracts.statement: No head ever caches a query's result; the only carve-out is ClickHouse's own result_cache, stamped solely on closed, now()-free windows, per CLAUDE.md invariant 12.
blind_spots: This contract pins the absence of a forbidden pattern; it cannot prove no equivalent caching effect is achieved through some other undetected mechanism.
